trickyParts: Measured on omp 18.8.9: after abort_and_restore_queue, agent_end (aborted) arrives idle with no pending message and nothing follows; after a plain abort, agent_end arrives idle with pending messages and a new run starts 3 ms later and writes them; pi.sendMessage returns while the host still reads idle and empty, so a card handed since the last host moment is never re-handed.
deviations: Withdrawn cards are handed again at the next heartbeat (90 s default), not at agent_end.

A live frame on a topic the stream does not keep (team or ad-hoc), held when the host switches away from its session, is not shown after the switch back: the switch releases its claim for a sweep that cannot see it. Keeping it pending instead would block another session's sweep of a shared retained topic in the same process. Team topics are documented live only.
A person's turn omp withdraws on an interrupt is handed back to the editor or RPC caller by omp itself and is not re-sent.
